results.content: As of Wednesday, an average of national polls compiled by Silver Bulletin showed 38.4% of voters approve of the president, while the Economist's tracker of polls by YouGov showed his approval at just 35%. But among the 22 states in which more voters approve of his performance than disapprove, according to polling by Morning Consult, Idaho ranks behind only Wyoming as the most pro-Trump state, with 60% approving and 37% who disapprove.
